name: deca
source: Wang et al., Learning Robust Recommenders through Cross-Model Agreement, WWW 2022; github.com/wangyu-ustc/DeCA @ 8b04aa8 (train.py, model.py, configs.py)
grid_source: Authors' configs.py tunes C1, C2 in {10, 100, 1000} and alpha in {0, 0.5, 1} per dataset and backbone (e.g. LightGCN Adressa C1 10, C2 1000, alpha 0). 8-trial budget: the corners C1 {10, 1000} x C2 {10, 1000} x alpha {0, 1}; the authors' per-dataset choices lie on or between these; our choice.
memory: Three extra MF models of 32 dimensions (about 10 MB on Amazon-Book) and their Adam states; one propagation per batch as Plain-BCE; expected 1.3 to 1.8 times the time of Plain-BCE
